translations.privacy.intro: Climweb Weather App is developed by WMO-RAF (World Meteorological Organisation - Regional Office for Africa) and Norway MET (Meteorologisk institutt). We are committed to protecting your privacy.
translations.privacy.dataCollected.title: Information We Collect
translations.privacy.dataCollected.text: Climweb Weather App does not collect, store, or share any personal information. You do not need to register or provide any personal details to use the app.
translations.privacy.location.title: Use of Location Data
translations.privacy.location.text: To show you accurate weather forecasts and alerts for your area, the app uses your device's location. Your location is used only to fetch weather data for that spot and is not linked to your identity or stored on our servers.
translations.privacy.favourites.title: Your Favourite Places
translations.privacy.favourites.text: If you save favourite places, they are stored only on your device. This information is never sent to us or shared with anyone else. You can add, change, or remove your favourite places at any time from the Places tab.
translations.privacy.security.title: Data Security
translations.privacy.security.text: We take data security seriously. Since we do not collect or store personal data, our focus is on keeping the app's forecast and alert services accurate and reliable.
translations.privacy.children.title: Children's Privacy
translations.privacy.children.text: Climweb Weather App is designed to be used by people of all ages, including children. We do not collect personal information from children or any other users.
translations.privacy.thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
translations.privacy.thirdParty.text: The app may contain links to third-party websites or services that we do not operate. If you tap a third-party link, you will be taken to that third party's site. We encourage you to read their privacy policies, as we are not responsible for their content or practices.
translations.privacy.changes.title: Changes to This Policy
translations.privacy.changes.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page.
translations.privacy.contact.title: Contact Us
translations.privacy.contact.text: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact WMO-RAF (World Meteorological Organisation - Regional Office for Africa) or Norway MET (Meteorologisk institutt).

translations.how.we.started.desc: We began with volunteers and enthusiasts in the 1890s. Later in the 1940s, we started providing weather services for local aviation. Today, we provide reliable weather services across globe. We cover aviation, marine, agriculture, livestock management, and more.
translations.our.mandate.desc: To monitor, predict and provide information on weather and climate, that would contribute towards the socio-economic development of the country.
translations.our.mission.desc: To provide reliable, responsive and high quality weather and climate services to meet national, regional and international obligations through timely dissemination of accurate and up to-date data and information for socio-economic development.
translations.our.vision.desc: A Responsive Nation to Weather and Climate Change Impacts
translations.app.and.forecasts.desc:
